64cb300f9b.why: The shuffle masks, multiply coefficients, and averaging operand are arbitrary, and both vector results plus the pointer and counter updates are live, leaving no removable stage in this SSSE3 sequence.

f432c5cfc5.why: SSE2 cannot widen the eight required 128-bit stores, and both the pointer update and flag-producing decrement remain necessary.

a3b7379519.why: SSSE3 provides no wider store to combine the four independently addressed writes, and the pointer update and decrement are live.

b2987eca26.why: All eight 128-bit stores and both scalar updates are required, and SSSE3 has no wider vector store.

0c8145bdd1.why: The four separately indexed stores cannot be combined under SSE2, and the final pointer, counter, and flags require both scalar instructions.

2c53b863af.why: The eight stores write two distinct live vectors across unknown strides, and SSE2 offers no wider store to reduce their count.

5c112a2d8e.why: The two unpacks and two shuffles construct the required byte repetitions in both live vectors, while all four stores and both scalar updates remain necessary.

678e6f046a.why: The two arbitrary shuffle masks require separate destructive PSHUFB operations and a source copy, with both resulting vectors and all stores live.

c25a3bf367.why: Four arbitrary live masks require four separate PSHUFB results, and legacy SSSE3 needs the source copies before those destructive shuffles.

9b63bf07e5.why: The four arbitrary masked shuffles need their source copies, and all eight stores are required at the maximum vector width allowed by SSSE3.

f6bcdf05c1.why: SSE2 requires the byte widening and word replication steps, and the zero vector, corner broadcast, difference, and final rcx value must all be preserved.

35292a3db1.why: Both broadcasts and additions feed required row results, and the full word sum in xmm2 remains live after packing, preventing elimination of that intermediate.

ce614951c6.why: The two broadcasts feed four separate word sums, with xmm5 and xmm7 also live after packing, so the copies and arithmetic remain necessary under SSE2.

03a0fe6f48.why: All eight word additions feed required results, four unpacked sums remain live, and SSE2 needs the existing broadcasts, copies, packs, and stores.

4e211fd9b0.why: The zeroing is needed for byte-to-word widening, and both loaded masks plus the corner broadcast and difference must be preserved.
